name: B10-0218/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Venezuela. It condemns the United States military intervention that removed Nicolás Maduro in January 2026. It says the Amnesty Law passed in February did not protect victims' rights or hold anyone responsible, and it regrets that detention records were erased. It calls for the release of all people held for political reasons, for a transitional government, and for free elections.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and set of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Venezuela's interim authorities, its attorney general and ombudswoman, and people detained for political reasons.
- **What happens next:** The text is sent to the Council, the Commission and Venezuelan authorities. Follow-up depends on them.
